items.title: Widerspruch against termination of Verletztengeld
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats Widerspruch erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Beispiel-Berufsgenossenschaft Bau und Holz, Unfallweg 4, 30159 Musterhannover.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 13.12.2024, sent by ordinary post by a social-insurance body (Berufsgenossenschaft). Per § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, as stated in the letter itself ('gilt am dritten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben'), the letter counts as delivered on the 3rd day after posting: Mon 16.12.2024. Per § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the one-month objection period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) starts the next day, 16.12.2024, and ends (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) on the corresponding date one month later: Thu 16.01.2025. That day is a working day in both NW and Niedersachsen, so no shift applies.

warnings: The letter also states a payment of 1.064,25 € to the recipient for 01.12.-15.12.2024 ('Überweisen wir Ihnen noch 1.064,25 €') but gives no date by which this transfer will be made, so no payment deadline could be set for it.
The 3-day deemed-delivery rule quoted in the letter reflects § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X as it stood before 2025; this was correctly applied here since the letter predates the later change to 4 days.
